operator_io_quirks: Table 'orderdetails' is declared with double quotes in DDL; sqlite_master name is 'orderdetails' (lowercase) — keep original spelling, quote on write.

orderdetails FKs use column-level 'references orders' / 'references products' with NULL parent column -> parent column = same name (orderNumber, productCode); pragma foreign_key_list returns NULL parent col.
employees has a self-FK reportsTo -> employees(employeeNumber); process_order must ignore the table self-edge or it cycles.

orders.orderDate/requiredDate/shippedDate and payments.paymentDate declared DATE but stored as TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD'; ts_fuzzer dispatches to Date (first element not int-parsable) — Date template %Y-%m-%d.

productlines.image declared BLOB, all NULL, distinct=0; ts_fuzzer String (blob -> String) with empty element list -> p:=1, fresh random strings over a-zA-Z0-9() — will insert text into a BLOB column (sqlite affinity allows).
productlines.htmlDescription all NULL, distinct=0; String sampler with no elements -> always fresh random strings.
customers.creditLimit REAL, null_rate 0.0 but notnull=0; Number sampler may emit NULLs? No — Number never emits None; but original has no NULLs so NOT NULL not enforced in Python anyway.
customers.contactFirstName samples have trailing spaces ('Carine ', 'Janine ') — String sampler preserves them; equality/join tests may be sensitive.

offices.officeCode / employees.officeCode are TEXT holding digit strings ('1'..'7'); String sampler will produce non-numeric strings, breaking FK joins to offices if parent filtered — but FK fill copies parent values so consistent.
payments composite PK (customerNumber, checkNumber); orderdetails composite PK (orderNumber, productCode) — composite-PK members get max_l0=30 cap.
orderdetails has 2996 rows, largest table; still small, no rowid sampling needed (max_rows_per_table 300000).

customers.salesRepEmployeeNumber FK to employees, null_rate 0.18; employees.reportsTo null_rate 0.043 — FK fill draws with replacement from parent final values, may produce NULLs only if parent empty.
operator_ts_expectations: Date fuzzer on orders/payments date columns: template %Y-%m-%d, range from min/max parsed originals (~2003-2005), fresh dates uniform in that range; p=0.2 means element returned w.p. 0.2 (inverted) so mostly fresh dates.

String fuzzer on names/cities/phones/emails: fresh random strings over a-zA-Z 0-9() length 0..20, plus contaminate suffix/prefix/drop — implausible values (e.g. 'aB3()x') drive FN on LIKE/equality predicates.

Number fuzzer on INTEGER PKs (employeeNumber, customerNumber, orderNumber): range [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from type args (none -> default), perturb +-1/+-2 — PKs become huge/negative, breaking range predicates and joins to literal pools.

Number fuzzer on REAL (creditLimit, amount, buyPrice, MSRP, priceEach): float perturb +-0.01/+-0.02, range from type args; creditLimit originals ~21000-118200 but sampler range may be much wider -> implausible values.
String fuzzer on productCode ('S10_1678') and checkNumber ('HQ336336'): fresh random strings lose the prefix pattern; LIKE 'S%' predicates get FN.
productScale ('1:10') and territory ('NA','EMEA') are low-cardinality enums but String fuzzer emits random strings -> ENUM-like predicates (IN, =) get FN.
status ('Shipped','Resolved',...) low-cardinality; String fuzzer random -> status='Shipped' predicates FN.
FK fill copies parent final values with replacement, so joins survive; but parent PK filtering (sample_fresh_primary_keys) may drop rows, and child draws from filtered parent — consistent.

Self-FK employees.reportsTo draws from employees.employeeNumber final values; if employeeNumber PK filtered, some reportsTo may reference dropped rows -> FK violation at insert, row skipped (writedb counts).

Composite PK orderdetails/payments: sample_fresh_primary_keys drops duplicate (orderNumber,productCode) tuples; with small parent cardinality many rows dropped -> small tables, missing ties/duplicates -> FP on COUNT/GROUP BY.
Empty-element columns (image, htmlDescription) always fresh random strings; image BLOB gets text — queries filtering image IS NULL get FN (no NULLs generated).
String sampler adds str(i+1)/str(i-1) for int-like elements; officeCode '1'..'7' gets '2','0' etc. — may collide with other offices, but PK filter drops duplicates.
